title: finalVerification runs on the phase-terminal node, never before
proves: finalVerificationCommands in final-verification.mjs appends contract.finalVerification only to the one node no other node depends on; every other node's own controller verification never sees it. The finalVerification command here is unconditionally false, so its presence or absence in a node's verification list is directly observable from that node's own outcome: build has a dependant (ship), so finalVerificationCommands returns [] for it and build closes done on its own taskPacket verification alone, which pins the negative half (never runs before the phase-terminal node); ship has no dependant, so the same always-failing command is appended to its verification list and ship's otherwise-passing attempt settles as a verification failure because of it, which pins the positive half (it does run on the phase-terminal node) — a run that dropped contract.finalVerification entirely, or attached it to the wrong node, would leave a different pair of outcomes than done/failed.

contract.goal: prove finalVerification runs only on the phase-terminal node
